dimensions.measurement: Join every declared requirement to an accepted assertion result for the exact patch digest.
dimensions.zero_credit: Any requirement is missing, skipped, or evaluated against another candidate.

dimensions.measurement: Run all declared focused checks and record exact pass fail skip counts.
dimensions.full_credit: Failure and unexplained skip counts equal zero.
dimensions.zero_credit: A focused check fails, is omitted, or is retried into green without repair.

dimensions.measurement: Exercise the production entrypoint when the requirement affects runtime behavior.
dimensions.full_credit: The declared journey passes the production entrypoint or a deterministic rule marks it non-applicable.
dimensions.zero_credit: Fixture-only proof is substituted for applicable production behavior.

dimensions.measurement: Compare changed and dirty paths with contract write scope and starting attribution.
dimensions.full_credit: Unattributed out-of-scope path count equals zero.
dimensions.zero_credit: Any unrelated change is included or existing work is reverted.

dimensions.measurement: Independently check affected authority, privacy, release, and security invariants.
dimensions.full_credit: Critical regression count equals zero and required independent review is accepted.
dimensions.zero_credit: A critical regression or self-approved critical package remains.
